use: Settlement and revenue work; the officer in the district
subject: A district officer walking his fields with the village accountant. The Englishman in a solar topi and light drill stands among the standing wheat with a cloth map opened in both hands, stooping to look where an elderly cultivator is pointing. The village accountant walks behind with a bundle of papers under his arm, and a boy carries a measuring chain. Green and gold fields laid out in flat bands, a well and its bullock at the right, a village of flat-roofed houses along the top. Bright cold-weather morning.
